Name: Denial of Service
ShortDescription: Denial of Service happens when the process or a datastore is not able to service incoming requests or perform up to spec

Name: Elevation of Privileges
ShortDescription: A user subject gains increased capability or privilege by taking advantage of an implementation bug

Name: Information Disclosure
ShortDescription: Information disclosure happens when the information can be read by an unauthorized party

Name: Repudiation
ShortDescription: Repudiation threats involve an adversary denying that something happened

Name: Spoofing
ShortDescription: Spoofing is when a process or entity is something other than its claimed identity. Examples include substituting a process, a file, website or a network address

Name: Tampering
ShortDescription: Tampering is the act of altering the bits. Tampering with a process involves changing bits in the running process. Similarly, Tampering with a data flow involves changing bits on the wire or between two running processes
